name: Non-human identity
short_description: A non-human identity is a digital identity used by software rather than a person, such as a service principal, managed identity or AI agent identity, that authenticates and acts on resources and therefore needs its own ownership, permission scoping and revocation path.

evidence.quote: Now, a non-human identity can trigger real world actions at machine speed.
Non-human identities are the fastest growing risk multiplier in the enterprise.
